debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme macro stress (VIX crisis, inverted yield curve, high credit spreads, NFP today), high earnings risk in 19 days, overbought short-term conditions, weak ADX trend strength, below-average volume, and zero fundamental/insider conviction make this a high-risk, low-conviction setup.
